title: Fireground Information Update

nodes.text: Operations Officer initiates Red Flag Warning

evidence.source_text: Step 1: For example, if the Operations Officer initiates a Red Flag Warning, they issue it to Division Commanders.
The Operations Officer then advises the Incident Controller.

nodes.text: Division Commanders acknowledge receipt and repeat back key points

evidence.source_text: Step 2: Division Commanders acknowledge receipt and repeat back the key points of the Warning to demonstrate understanding.

nodes.text: Division Commanders issue Red Flag Warning to Sector Commanders

evidence.source_text: Step 3: Division Commanders issue the Red Flag Warning to Sector Commanders.

nodes.text: Sector Commanders acknowledge receipt and repeat back key points

evidence.source_text: Step 4: Sector Commanders acknowledge receipt and repeat back the key points of the Warning to demonstrate understanding.

nodes.text: Sector Commanders issue Warning to Strike Team/Task Force Leaders

evidence.source_text: Step 5: Sector Commanders issue Warning to Strike Team/Task Force Leaders and any others they are supervising.

nodes.text: Strike Team/Task Force Leaders acknowledge receipt
Strike Team/Task Force Leaders issue Warning to crew members

evidence.source_text: and issue the Warning to their crew members (Step 7).
